text:
Which products are formed when magnesium carbonate reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid?
A
carbon dioxide, hydrogen and magnesium chloride
B
carbon dioxide and magnesium chloride only
C
carbon dioxide, water and magnesium chloride
D
water and magnesium chloride only

options.label: A
options.text: carbon dioxide, hydrogen and magnesium chloride

options.label: B
options.text: carbon dioxide and magnesium chloride only

options.label: C
options.text: carbon dioxide, water and magnesium chloride
